title: Achmea Investment Management B.V. Sells 138,476 Shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Posted by Jennifer Salazar on Jan 1st, 2018 // No Comments 
Achmea Investment Management B.V. lowered its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 23.6% during the second quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the SEC. The institutional investor owned 449,395 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 138,476 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises approximately 3.9% of Achmea Investment Management B.V.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its biggest holding. Achmea Investment Management B.V.’s holdings in Apple were worth $64,716,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.

Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) opened at $169.23 on Monday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73, a current ratio of 1.28 and a quick ratio of 1.23. Apple Inc. has a one year low of $114.76 and a one year high of $177.20. The company has a market cap of $878,380.00, a PE ratio of 18.41, a P/E/G ratio of 1.35 and a beta of 1.24. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 2nd. The iPhone maker reported $2.07 EPS for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $1.87 by $0.20. Apple had a net margin of 21.09% and a return on equity of 36.29%. The business had revenue of $52.58 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $50.71 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the company posted $1.50 earnings per share. Apple’s revenue was up 12.2% compared to the same quarter last year. research analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.18 EPS for the current fiscal year.
